sahneler.metin: A powerful earthquake struck northwest Turkey before dawn.
Thousands of buildings collapsed, and about seventeen thousand people died.
Their ground floors were often open shops with few walls.
Concrete quality and steel detailing were frequently poor.
Codes existed but were weakly enforced.
Turkey then introduced compulsory earthquake insurance and tighter inspections.

aciklama:
Izmit earthquake collapsed many apartment buildings. The cause: soft-storey failures and poor concrete and detailing in reinforced concrete frames.
